segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, oily skin found the clear patches reduced the size and redness of blemishes, though not as dramatically as a salicylic-acid version might, and warns that re-peeling or repositioning them can irritate skin near the jawline where there is fine hair.
segments.oily: The same reviewer with sensitive, oily skin felt the patches absorbed oil from her skin as much as they drew out pus from the actual pimple.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report the clear patches shrink pimples and draw out pus or gunk within hours to overnight, including several describing help with cystic or hormonal chin acne and one calling them effective on bug bites; dissent exists — one reviewer said a patch left on for over a day tore her skin and drew blood without pulling anything out, another found the patches simply didn't stay on long enough to work, and a third got better results from Mighty Patch.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report the patches visibly reduce redness and swelling around blemishes, often overnight, and several specifically praise the clear/neutral color for muting redness under makeup or from a distance.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers also credit continued use with fading dark marks and discoloration left by old breakouts, in addition to covering active pimples.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin felt the patches absorbed noticeable oil from her skin, in addition to pulling fluid from the pimple itself.

aspects.libelle: Stays on through sweat and showers
Removal can be fiddly or irritate skin
Outer packaging felt oversized for contents

extraits.titre: 10/10 Looks, 1/10 Performance: Do NOT Leave On Too Long!
extraits.texte: It didn't really do anything compared to other patches I have used before. I also kept one on for too long (a day and night). It ended up ripping off my skin. I was bleeding. Maybe I misunderstood what pimple patches do, but I'll stick to the ones that do what I want (successfully pulling out the white of pimples). So altough the product looks good, and does the invisible part well. I think the fact that it doesn't pull out the white and also caused me to bleed, overall puts the product at a 1 out of 5 stars.
Starface patches never stay on my name - it doesnt matter the color, the shape, they slip right off even though my face is clean and dry.

i bought these because i love how cute they look and was excited to try these out but unforunately they did not work for me. compared to the mighty patches where i saw a considerate difference after using it for a few days.

extraits.titre: I wasnt expecting any miricles, but they do help!
extraits.texte: Think of these as more of a bandaid. I notoriously pick at my skin and these do reduce the size and redness. Its a lot quicker healing than just leaving them as is. I'm sure the blue salicylic acid once would have better results with stubborn acne. I like these clear ones since once you put them on theyre practically invisible. (Just dont stick and re-peel then you'll see em) I have sensitive oily skin so it seems like they absorb the oil off my skin more than the actual pimple pus. And if you were wondering No, these arent meant to help blackheads and wont do anything for those. (I tried experimentally, but didnt expect anything) *Note some spots left a tiny bit of sticky residue and on the further sides of your face near the jawline might have irritation when you take them off due to baby hairs. Make sure you wash your face when you take them off!

These spot patches are exceptionally sticky and slightly cushioned, providing real protection and gradually drawing up painful deep cysts. I suffer from monthly hormonal acne on my chin, resulting in weeping wounds and scarring. The patches conceal the unsightly and uncomfortable areas while my skin heals up during my period. I prefer these patches because they stick so strongly, they smooth, camouflage the area and blend into my brown complexion nicely as they are transparent. I need a life time supply, it was so hard to deal with my cystic chin acne before I found this product. Starface can you please sell packs of just the large stars as refill options?

The variety - both the XL and regular stars - helps cover any size spot or blemish. The neutral color of these stars really reduces redness and inflammation. Usually neutral colors still look orange on my pasty, computer-tanned skin. These stars literally disappear over my pimples and red discoloration marks from old blemishes. I like these stars specifically for times when I want to look clean but can't wear a cute brightly colored star for the occasion.

These have become a staple in my routine and blend in super well under makeup because of its clear design. These have helped me reduce redness in my skin from breakouts and reduced dark spots from acne scarring. Overall 10/10 and definitely a lot more clear/invincible on the skin than some other clear patches I've tried!
